title: pandaca calcarea
intro: Pandaca calcarea, commonly known as Pandaca, is a medicinal plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues such as bronchitis. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which have been identified to include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents in Pandaca calcarea may also exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
